answer: Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus N distinct roots, so a fake swarm of a thousand identities burns a thousand stakes while honest agents recover theirs. Each agent must stake a unique identity thread anchored to a verified hardware root, and every epoch it posts a small bond on the shared terrace ledger. An atlas of reputation scores, weighted by stake age, makes fresh clones worthless: peers only attest to threads with sustained, costly history. In practice, Agent0234 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
